title: Cardinality of the Bounded Reachability Set
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x$ be a binary string, and let $s,K$ be natural numbers. If $2^{\kappa(N)(s+\ell(x)+1)}\le K$, where $\kappa(N)$ is the configuration-code width parameter and $\ell(x)=\lfloor\log_2 |x|\rfloor+1$, then the number of integers $u<K$ reachable from the encoded initial configuration by a finite chain of encoded one-step transitions that stay within the radius-$s$ window equals the number of such integers $u<2^{\kappa(N)(s+\ell(x)+1)}$.
hypotheses_covered: N is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet.
s and K are natural numbers.
